title: Pooled, naive, and tailored scoring of forecasts without knowledge of the day

metadata.permutation_rng_stream: cases_model_fixed_permutation.generate_permuted_targets, with Table 4 cohort order REPLACE-BG, CTN-0094, College Experience
metadata.permutation_method: Within-patient shuffle of scored outcomes; run-in outcomes fixed; updated/expanding rate rebuilt with table4_v10.rebuild_updated_rate; no model fitting or model rescoring.
metadata.pooled_chance_definitions: AUC 0.5; AP/PPV scored-set event rate; NPV scored-set non-event rate; sensitivity/specificity training-cohort rate/complement; NB treat-none/treat-all; Brier skill 0; calibration slope 1.
metadata.naive_slope_chance_definition: n/a for the constant run-in forecast; slope 1 (calibrated twin) when the shuffled running forecast yields an estimable within-patient slope
metadata.tailored_chance_definition: the score of the no-within-patient-information forecast itself; for run-in by construction and for shuffled running rate each draw's rebuilt forecast
